verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Kick's docs serve an llms.txt index (HTTP 200 at docs.kick.co/llms.txt). The docs also document .md markdown mirrors on every page and an agent-queryable '?ask=' interface, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-legible Kick documentation. These surfaces are generated by GitBook, but they are published on Kick's own docs domain with Kick's content, which meets the story as written. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent actually consuming these docs, and evidence of Kick-authored agent-specific guidance beyond the platform-generated index.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.kick.co/llms.txt # Kick Docs
Perform an HTTP GET request on the current page URL with the ask query parameter... The response will contain a direct answer to the question and relevant excerpts and sources from the documentation.
